title: Swim in Rising Water
summary: At time t, a cell is available if its elevation is at most t.

contractDetails.constraints: An n × n grid with 1 ≤ n ≤ 50. Elevations are distinct integers in [0, n²).

statement: At time t, a cell is available if its elevation is at most t. Move across shared sides between available cells. Find the earliest time when the upper-left and lower-right cells are connected.

examples.explanation: Go down to elevation 1, then right to elevation 2.
The destination itself has elevation 3, so no earlier route can finish.
The sole cell is available immediately.

constraints: An n × n grid with 1 ≤ n ≤ 50. Elevations are distinct integers in [0, n²).
hints: Conceptual: A route becomes usable at its highest elevation.
Directional: If the target is reachable at one time, it stays reachable later.
Implementation: Binary-search the time. For each candidate, use a traversal that visits only cells at or below that threshold.
complexityAnalysis: O(n² log n) time and O(n²) auxiliary space for binary search and iterative grid traversal.
